title: PubTables-v2: A new large-scale dataset for full-page and multi-page table extraction
method: dataset plus VLM/page-model/continuation baselines
notes: Evidence: 9172 documents contain 9492 multi-page tables; the ViT-B/16 continuation classifier reaches about 0.991 F1. On Full Documents, Claude Opus 4.6 has the highest Acc_Top 0.5799 and Acc_Con 0.2452, while Gemini 3.1 Pro has the highest GriTS_Con 0.9309. Limitation: evaluation includes every table in documents containing multi-page or multi-column tables and does not isolate merging from page extraction; multipart tables lack row/column bounding boxes.

title: POTATR: A Lightweight Image-to-Graph Model for Page-Level Table Extraction
method: 29M DETR image-to-graph page extractor composed with ViT continuation and vertical merge
notes: Evidence: POTATR plus merging reports Full Documents Acc_Top 0.4234, Acc_Con 0.2176, and GriTS_Con 0.8269; its Single Pages GriTS_Con is 0.964. Limitation: POTATR is trained on single pages, leaves multi-page optimization and within-page part merging out of scope, and uses simple vertical concatenation after continuation classification.

title: Application of BERT-Based Semantic Matching Algorithm for Cross-Page Table Recognition
method: two-stage table segmentation plus BERT next-sentence semantic matching
notes: Evidence: directly formulates cross-page recognition and uses BERT semantic matching to decide whether page fragments continue; limitation: financial-domain text segmentation is detached from layout parsing and does not recover column/row correspondences or report document-level structural metrics.

title: VCCT: Vocabulary Constraint and Cross-page Context for Table Recognition in Power Grid Fault Reports
method: vocabulary constraint plus cross-page context fusion and header/border pre-recognition
notes: Evidence: on 300 private cross-page tables, SIR is 82.0% and data accuracy is 86.3%; SIR requires no column misalignment, complete row retention, and precise header alignment. Limitation: domain-specific private data, no public code, unreviewed SSRN status, nonstandard metric, and serious citation-quality concerns prevent a general reproducible SOTA claim.

title: LingDT-VL-OCR: Structure-Aware Document-Level Parsing with Fine-Grained Visual Reference
method: page-wise VLM parsing plus adaptive heuristic cross-page content consolidation
notes: Evidence: FinDocBench contains 1044 tables, including 472 spanning at least two pages; LingDT-VL-OCR reports mean TEDS 0.8915 on the 472 cross-page instances. Limitation: no exact-match score or same-subset competing baseline is reported, and no public dataset or code link was found in the paper.

title: PubTables-1M: Towards comprehensive table extraction from unstructured documents
method: DETR Table Transformer with canonicalized cell and header annotations
notes: Evidence: nearly one million scientific tables with detailed boxes and canonicalization support detection structure and functional analysis using one transformer family; limitation: examples are individual tables/pages and provide no cross-page identity or continuation labels.

title: Image-based table recognition: data model and evaluation
method: attention encoder dual decoder generating HTML
notes: Evidence: 568k table images and the EDD model improve complex-table TEDS by 9.7 absolute points over the reported prior state of the art; limitation: cropped-table HTML generation discards surrounding page and document relations.

title: GriTS: Grid Table Similarity Metric for Table Structure Recognition
method: 2D most-similar-substructure heuristic over table matrices
notes: Evidence: one matrix framework evaluates topology location and content and empirically gives almost identical upper/lower heuristic bounds; limitation: standard GriTS has no explicit table-chain or cross-page alignment component.

title: Aligning Benchmark Datasets for Table Structure Recognition
method: data canonicalization with fixed Table Transformer
notes: Evidence: aligned training raises ICDAR-2013 exact match from 69% to 81% for combined data without changing the model; limitation: alignment is page/table-level and does not define document-template-disjoint splits or cross-page labels.

title: TableFormer: Table Structure Understanding with Transformers
method: transformer structure decoder plus object-detection cell decoder
notes: Evidence: reports TEDS rising to 98.5% on simple and 95% on complex tables while using PDF text for cells; limitation: assumes a cropped single table and cannot associate fragments across pages.

title: TGRNet: A Table Graph Reconstruction Network for Table Structure Recognition
method: joint cell detection and logical row/column location prediction
notes: Evidence: explicitly predicts spatial boxes and logical row/column coordinates and validates on TableGraph-350K plus three public datasets; limitation: graphs terminate at one cropped table and do not model page or document nodes.

title: Complicated Table Structure Recognition
method: graph neural network predicting relations among table cells
notes: Evidence: introduces 15000 scientific tables with structure labels and improves relation prediction for spanning cells; limitation: starts from table cells and has no detection layout hierarchy or cross-page graph.

title: Robust Table Detection and Structure Recognition from Heterogeneous Document Images
method: CornerNet proposals plus split-and-merge Spatial/Grid CNN
notes: Evidence: one system is evaluated across three detection and three structure benchmarks and targets blank space and geometric distortion; limitation: heterogeneous pages are still processed independently and merge means cells within one table.

title: CascadeTabNet: An approach for end to end table detection and structure recognition from image-based documents
method: Cascade Mask R-CNN HRNet jointly detecting tables and body cells
notes: Evidence: a single CNN handles detection and body-cell segmentation with competitive reported results on three benchmarks; limitation: output lacks semantic hierarchy and page-to-page table identity.

title: Global Table Extractor (GTE): A Framework for Joint Table Identification and Cell Structure Recognition Using Visual Context
method: joint table identification and cell structure using page visual context
notes: Evidence: page context jointly supports table localization and cell recovery and introduced FinTabNet-scale financial annotations; limitation: global means one page and the method does not form document-level table chains.

title: Divide Rows and Conquer Cells: Towards Structure Recognition for Large Tables
method: row decomposition followed by cell reconstruction for large tables
notes: Evidence: explicitly targets large-table decoding and is cited by later long-table and TSR work; limitation: large means many rows within a crop rather than fragments split by document pagination.

title: DocParser: Hierarchical Document Structure Parsing from Renderings
task: hierarchical document parsing and relation prediction
method: entity detection plus hierarchical relation classification
notes: Evidence: weak supervision improves entity mAP by 39.1% and hierarchical-relation F1 by 35.8% over its baseline; limitation: the published hierarchy is inferred per rendering/page and does not define multi-page table alignment relations.

title: HRDoc: Dataset and Baseline Method Toward Hierarchical Reconstruction of Document Structures
task: hierarchical document parsing and relation prediction
method: multimodal encoder and structure-aware GRU decoder
notes: Evidence: 2500 multi-page documents contain nearly two million line-level semantic units with category and relation labels; limitation: scientific document hierarchy stops at semantic lines/sections and does not annotate internal cross-page table structure.

title: Detect-Order-Construct: A Tree Construction based Approach for Hierarchical Document Structure Analysis
task: hierarchical document parsing and relation prediction
method: joint object detection reading order and tree construction
notes: Evidence: evaluates a unified three-stage hierarchy pipeline on four layout/hierarchy benchmarks and reports state-of-the-art results; limitation: table cells and cross-page table fragment alignment are not modeled as dedicated relations.

title: DocHieNet: A Large and Diverse Dataset for Document Hierarchy Parsing
task: hierarchical document parsing and relation prediction
method: document hierarchy dataset and parsing baselines
notes: Evidence: supplies a large diverse hierarchy benchmark beyond a single scientific template and evaluates document-level parent relations; limitation: hierarchy parsing does not reconstruct row/column topology inside tables or pair table fragments.

title: DocGraphLM: Documental Graph Language Model for Information Extraction
method: language model plus learned graph reconstruction using direction and distance link prediction
notes: Evidence: graph features consistently improve IE/QA on three datasets and accelerate convergence; limitation: learned neighborhood links are page-local proxies and are not supervised for layout hierarchy or cross-page table semantics.

title: LayoutReader: Pre-training of Text and Layout for Reading Order Detection
task: hierarchical document parsing and relation prediction
method: seq2seq reading-order pretraining from Word XML
notes: Evidence: automatically constructs 500000 document images with reading-order labels and substantially improves OCR ordering; limitation: ordering is a sequence rather than typed hierarchy and contains no table-fragment identity.

title: Relationformer: A Unified Framework for Image-to-Graph Generation
method: Deformable DETR with relation token for joint node and edge prediction
notes: Evidence: demonstrates end-to-end image-to-graph prediction and is the architectural comparator used by POTATR; limitation: benchmarks are scene/road graphs rather than documents and contain no text or pagination.

title: MMLongBench-Doc: Benchmarking Long-context Document Understanding with Visualizations
method: benchmark of long-context LVLM question answering
notes: Evidence: 1062 questions over 130 documents averaging 49.4 pages include 33.2% cross-page questions and best-model F1 only 42.7%; limitation: QA answers/evidence pages do not supply table reconstruction annotations.

title: mPLUG-DocOwl2: High-resolution Compressing for OCR-free Multi-page Document Understanding
method: 324-token DocCompressor with three-stage multi-image training
notes: Evidence: reduces first-token latency by over 50% and reports state-of-the-art multi-page QA with evidence-page and cross-page structure tasks; limitation: generative answers do not guarantee spatially grounded table topology or deterministic merging.

title: SmolDocling: An Ultra-Compact Vision-Language Model for End-To-End Multi-Modal Document Conversion
method: 256M VLM generating spatial DocTags
notes: Evidence: one compact model emits located markup for tables equations charts code and other elements across diverse domains; limitation: inference is page-oriented and does not define document-level table continuation or alignment.

title: dots.ocr: Multilingual Document Layout Parsing in a Single Vision-Language Model
method: unified end-to-end layout detection OCR and relation generation
notes: Evidence: joint training covers layout text and relations and reports about 10% relative gain on 126-language XDocParse; limitation: the released task is page parsing and PubTables-v2 shows page-by-page document GriTS_Con only 0.577 before external merging.

title: olmOCR: Unlocking Trillions of Tokens in PDFs with Vision Language Models
method: 7B VLM for linearized Markdown with scalable PDF pipeline
notes: Evidence: releases model data training and pipeline and reports processing cost of 176 USD per million pages on diverse PDFs; limitation: output is linearized page text and benchmark units do not measure cross-page table chain or column alignment.

title: DocLayNet: A Large Human-Annotated Dataset for Document-Layout Analysis
method: human-annotated 11-class layout detection benchmark
notes: Evidence: 80863 diverse pages show models trained on scientific-only corpora generalize poorly and remain about 10% below human agreement; limitation: page boxes have no cross-page relations and tables lack internal structure.

title: Document Domain Randomization for Deep Learning Document Layout Extraction
method: randomized synthetic document rendering for layout segmentation
notes: Evidence: CNNs trained only on randomized pseudo-pages transfer competitively to real ACL/VIS documents and experiments isolate style mismatch; limitation: synthetic page semantics are coarse and do not model consistent multi-page table templates.

title: Shortcut Learning in Deep Neural Networks
method: survey and framework for unintended shortcut features
notes: Evidence: synthesizes broad empirical evidence that high IID accuracy can rely on non-robust cues and fail under distribution shift; limitation: it is not document-specific and offers no ready-made table split protocol.

title: Data Leakage in Visual Datasets
method: dataset leakage audit and similarity analysis
notes: Evidence: shows visual overlap can inflate benchmark estimates and motivates grouping near-duplicate templates before splitting; limitation: the audit is generic visual recognition rather than PDF template or table-chain evaluation.

title: Granite Vision: a lightweight open-source multimodal model for enterprise intelligence
method: 2B decoder VLM with document instruction tuning
notes: Relevant compact VLM and contamination-aware LiveXiv evaluation; page-level output only and no cross-page table recovery protocol.

title: PubLayNet: Largest Dataset Ever for Document Layout Analysis
method: automatically aligned XML/PDF layout boxes
notes: Large scientific layout pretraining source but page boxes have only five classes and no document relations.

title: DocILE Benchmark for Document Information Localization and Extraction
method: KILE and line-item recognition benchmark with seen/few/zero-shot layouts
notes: Useful precedent for layout-disjoint evaluation with 6.7k annotated and 100k synthetic documents; targets invoices and IE rather than academic multi-page table reconstruction.

title: POTATR: A Lightweight Image-to-Graph Model for Page-Level Table Extraction (OpenAlex duplicate record)
method: duplicate metadata record
notes: duplicate

title: Table Detection in the Wild: A Novel Diverse Table Detection Dataset and Method
method: diverse table detection dataset plus CNN baseline
notes: Broadens table appearance domains but annotations stop at detection and contain no cross-page links.

title: LayoutParser: A Unified Toolkit for Deep Learning Based Document Image Analysis
method: modular layout detection and OCR toolkit
notes: Useful engineering baseline but a toolkit rather than a learned document-level table recovery method.

title: TableNet: Deep Learning Model for End-to-end Table Detection and Tabular Data Extraction from Scanned Document Images
method: encoder with table and column segmentation decoders
notes: Early joint table/column segmentation baseline; scanned page focus and no hierarchical or cross-page output.

title: DeepSeek-OCR 2: Visual Causal Flow
method: causal visual token flow for OCR and parsing
notes: Strong page parser included in current comparisons; no explicit cross-page table alignment or document-level graph output.

title: UniHDSA: A Unified Relation Prediction Approach for Hierarchical Document Structure Analysis
task: hierarchical document parsing and relation prediction
method: unified relation prediction for hierarchy
notes: Round-one forward citation extends relation prediction but does not introduce a new table-alignment annotation category.

title: Zero-Shot Table Extraction in Business Documents: A Unified Benchmark with Error Taxonomy and Ecological Analysis
method: zero-shot model comparison with ecological error taxonomy
notes: Important post-2025 generalization benchmark; business page extraction rather than cross-page scientific table recovery.

title: End to End Table Transformer
method: end-to-end transformer for structure and content
notes: Recent transformer baseline discovered by POTATR backward search; remains cropped/page-level.

title: SPRINT: Script-agnostic Structure Recognition in Tables
method: script-agnostic structure recognizer
notes: Useful for language robustness but no page context or table continuation.

title: DLAFormer: An End-to-End Transformer For Document Layout Analysis
method: end-to-end transformer layout detector
notes: Page-layout competitor discovered in hierarchy citation search; does not recover table structure or cross-page relations.

title: TRACE: Table Reconstruction Aligned to Corner and Edges
method: corner/edge aligned table reconstruction
notes: Potential strong page-level component but no document context or continuation decision.

title: TableBank: Table Benchmark for Image-based Table Detection and Recognition
method: Word/LaTeX weakly generated detection and recognition data
notes: Large weakly labeled source with template leakage risk; no multi-page identity.
